name: proxy-starter
notes: ADR-023 tier 1: an engineering gate. A number from this set decides whether a retrieval switch earns its place and is NEVER cited as a finding about CIT-U research. Question kinds follow docs/evaluation/README.md: paraphrased mechanism (the default), exact term or number, near-duplicate discrimination, and cross-paper; IR-463 adds general-knowledge, off-corpus-research, ambiguous, follow-up-after-direct and follow-up-after-grounded, which carry evidence_required and expected_outcome. Every quote is copied from the chunk text `manage.py inspect_chunks` prints, not from the PDF, because Docling respaces parentheses and maths.
